0022600159.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-4, 8th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back) host the Detroit Pistons (5-1, 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East), with Charlotte on a three-game losing streak and Detroit on a two-game winning streak. Detroit won the only meeting this season 97-89 in Detroit on October 28, 2026, and the Hornets also lost all three games to the Pistons in the 2025-26 season. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain).
